look_here_first: Start with scale and hairs: a very low suffrutescent mound with conspicuously ciliate opposite leaves and paired axillary pale pink-purple tubular flowers.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Travis and Bexar are exact target-zone records. Williamson is documented but is outside the project target-county list and does not count.

approval_exception.reason: Correct stale PASS while preserving learner admission.

best_field_traits: small opposite elliptic leaves with rounded tips
club-shaped capsule with up to four seeds
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Tiny, dry-site and hairy versus the tall glabrous aquatic Dianthera americana.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Low hairy dry-site mound + small ciliate leaves + paired axillary flowers.
